/-- A balanced tree of the given size. -/
structure Tree (size : Nat) where
  /-- The tree. -/
  impl : Impl α β
  /-- The tree is balanced. -/
  balanced_impl : impl.Balanced
  /-- The tree has size `size`. -/
  size_impl : impl.size = size
